title: Resolution required for topology inference

minimum.layered_vs_flat (V12 F03): at floor at 4 steps x 12 blocks; moderate at 32 x 12; strong at 32 x 60; near-perfect at 128 x 60
minimum.director_vs_brief (V13 H03, H14): artifact-only at floor at every resolution; separable only with correction records; the first sufficient record level is reported by H14
minimum.probes (Q08): a probe set below the divergence floor invalidates any active-selection claim

transfer_gap: V12 blocks and V13 events are segmented by construction; text segmentation adds error the ladder does not include.
sounding_line_target: the admissibility check before any topology score is reported
records_required: segmentable blocks or events at the stated counts
positive_gate: the ruler reaches its validated accuracy at the stated resolution on a planted corpus
failure_meaning: a topology score below the admissible resolution is a number without a ruler
human_evidence_boundary: resolution requirements are properties of these rulers on constructed data; they do not transfer to human evidence without remeasurement

H14.what_happened: Discrimination by record level: artifact 50%, timings 50%, proposals 50%, alternatives 50%, accept_veto 50%, role_map 47%, full_log 100%; the first level reaching 75% was full_log.

H03.what_happened: Director versus shared brief: artifact-only 50%, coherence 50%, interaction records 100% against 50% chance.

H13.what_happened: On artifacts that were literally the same, a classifier named the history 50% of the time against 50% chance, and the artifact-only reader's topology posterior stayed flat.

Q08.what_happened: Minimum discriminativeness by probe set: commission 0.007, channel 0.074, query 0.010; commissions differed pairwise by 0.288.
